title: Progress and perspectives on gas diffusion layers for proton exchange membrane fuel cells with high power density: from structural engineering to component integration
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00552C, Perspective
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Qinglin Wen, Xiaochun Zhou
This perspective summarizes design strategies for gas diffusion layers (GDLs), from the aspects of pore, wettability, interface and component integration, while also providing an outlook on the future development of GDLs and highly integrated fuel cells.
